en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large multi‑wing hospital complex on a gentle hill, seen from across a river or pond whose calm surface reflects the building. The foreground shows tall reeds at the water's edge and a grassy bank with small trees lining a path. The main building is several stories high with a hipped roof, dormers, many windows, and balconies; additional wings extend to the right. Printed caption text in German appears along the lower margin, with a small serial number at the bottom right.
